title: The hybrid ladder: code, SFT, per-document, GRPO
metric_note: Share of invoices whose eligible, blocked and deferred amounts are all within Rs 1 of the truth. Held-out test set, 120 simulator cases (60 in-distribution, 60 out-of-distribution), one number per bar.
source: reports/hybrid.md (Overall, 120 simulator cases) and reports/results.md at commit 83599e7; SFT compact row at da4120a. No value = TODO, not run yet. Commit under each bar = the reconciler (or report) commit behind the number.

context.title: Context accuracy and overclaim
context.sub: Same 120 test cases (SFT compact: a 30-case sample). Context = did the model apply the business context right (blocked and deferred reasons). Overclaim = rupees of credit wrongly claimed, per case.

footnotes: * Strict-grammar SFT forced junk into blocked and deferred (it was trained on compact targets): a format mismatch, not the student's accuracy. The compact bar is its real end-to-end number.

Not measured (GPU host down): base Qwen3-4B end-to-end. The hatched SFT compact-grammar bar is a 30-case simulator sample (CI 70.0 to 81.5), not the 120 cases of the other bars, so read it as indicative only.

Reconciler v1, v2 and v3 re-score the same cached per-document replies with no new model calls; the oracle check (true records through the same code) reproduces the truth on all cases under all three.
